comment: The Metric Definitions vocabulary for Microsoft.Compute/disks: every metric name, its unit and its supported aggregations, as the Metric_Catalog's entries for this type must be evidenced against (Req 2.1). Derived from Microsoft documentation rather than captured from a live subscription -- see `provenance`, which records the source per fixture and the basis for the supported-aggregation set per metric. Metric names are recorded as the source's 'Name in REST API' value and never as a portal display name: the two differ by exactly the case, whitespace and separator substitutions the near-miss rule rejects, and a near miss here would make a metric permanently uncollectable.

derived_from: Microsoft Learn, 'Supported metrics - Microsoft.Compute/disks' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/azure-monitor/reference/supported-metrics/microsoft-compute-disks-metrics): the 'Name in REST API', 'Unit', 'Aggregation', 'Dimensions' and 'Time Grains' columns. That page documents 'Aggregation' as the *default* aggregation type, which is why the supported-aggregation set carries a recorded basis per metric.

Microsoft Learn, 'Metric Definitions - List' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/monitor/metric-definitions/list): the response shape, being the `value` array and each definition's `namespace`, `name`, `unit`, `supportedAggregationTypes`, `metricAvailabilities` and `dimensions` fields.

aggregation_bases.compute_documented_default_widened_by_pl: The source publishes one aggregation, and the same provider's 'Percentage CPU' is recorded serving total, count, minimum and maximum (see 'compute_documented_default_widened_by_recorded_response'), so a single documented value is a default rather than a complete set for this provider. Widened to the five aggregations the Azure Metrics store serves for a platform metric whose per-interval record carries sum, count, minimum and maximum, as .kiro/steering/azure-integration.md section 5 records. WEAKEST BASIS IN THIS FILE: replace with a live capture when one is available.

provenance.selection: A subset of the metrics the source lists for this type: the utilization series this product collects, restricted to metrics whose unit is one the catalog's unit mapping covers. A subset fails closed -- a catalog entry naming a metric this fixture does not carry is rejected -- so an omission can block a metric but can never admit a wrong one. `omitted_metrics` records the candidates that were dropped and why.

omitted_metrics.name: DiskPaidBurstIOPS
omitted_metrics.reason: a billing counter rather than a utilization series, and the source publishes one aggregation with no recorded response covering it

omitted_fields: id and resourceId, which are fully qualified resource identifiers carrying a subscription id (Req 2.5 excludes both)

primaryAggregationType, isDimensionRequired, displayDescription, category, name.localizedValue and metricAvailabilities[].retention, none of which the source establishes -- omitted rather than invented
provenance.region_note: The source is not region-scoped. `region` records the (resource_type, region) pair this fixture stands in for, matching the Definition_Probe's cache key, and is the region the rest of this repository's Azure fixtures use.
